title: Warm and Comfortable
headline: Pleasantly warm. Great for outdoor plans with basic sun care.
quick: Light layers are all you need
Sunscreen still counts on warm days
Perfect for a walk or a cafe patio
notification: Nice and warm today. A good day to be outside.

do: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes before heading out
avoid: Sitting in a hot parked car
watchFor: Sunburn on shoulders, nose, and neck

travel: Great conditions for driving and cycling
Keep water in the car on longer trips
home: Turn AC on only when needed

people.kids: Great for outdoor play; apply sunscreen and offer water breaks.
people.elderly: Comfortable for a walk; go in shade if the sun is strong.
people.commuters: Comfortable for walking or cycling to work.
people.athletes: Good for training; hydrate and watch for heat climbing in the afternoon.

rules.tip: Getting close to hot: switch to the morning or evening for hard exercise.
